passages.text: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Command the Israelites and say to them: See that you present to Me at its appointed time the food for My offerings by fire, as a pleasing aroma to Me.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Moses.
The LORD gave Moses a command.
The LORD told Moses to command the Israelites.
The LORD told Moses to say to the Israelites:
You must present My offering at its appointed time.
You must bring the food for My offerings by fire.
These offerings are a pleasing aroma to Me.
passages.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃ צַ֚ו אֶת־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְאָמַרְתָּ֖ אֲלֵהֶ֑ם אֶת־ קָרְבָּנִ֨י לַחְמִ֜י לְאִשַּׁ֗י רֵ֚יחַ נִֽיחֹחִ֔י תִּשְׁמְר֕וּ לְהַקְרִ֥יב לִ֖י בְּמוֹעֲדֽוֹ׃

passages.text: And tell them that this is the offering made by fire you are to present to the LORD as a regular burnt offering each day: two unblemished year-old male lambs.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Moses.
God gave Moses instructions for the Israelites.
God told Moses to speak to the Israelites.
God said, “This is the offering you must bring to the LORD.”
The Israelites must bring an offering made by fire.
The Israelites must present this offering to the LORD every day.
The offering must be two male lambs.
Each lamb must be one year old.
Each lamb must have no blemish.
The Israelites must offer these two lambs as a regular burnt offering each day.
passages.original: וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ לָהֶ֔ם זֶ֚ה הָֽאִשֶּׁ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר תַּקְרִ֖יבוּ לַיהוָ֑ה כְּבָשִׂ֨ים בְּנֵֽי־ שָׁנָ֧ה תְמִימִ֛ם שְׁנַ֥יִם לַיּ֖וֹם עֹלָ֥ה תָמִֽיד׃

passages.text: Offer one lamb in the morning and the other at twilight, along with a tenth of an ephah of fine flour as a grain offering, mixed with a quarter hin of oil from pressed olives.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Moses.
God gave Moses instructions for the Israelites.
God commanded the Israelites to bring offerings to Him.
God required a regular burnt offering each day.
Offer one unblemished year-old male lamb in the morning.
Offer the second unblemished year-old male lamb at twilight.
Bring a grain offering with each lamb.
Use a tenth of an ephah of fine flour for the grain offering.
Mix the fine flour with a quarter hin of oil from pressed olives.
passages.original: אֶת־ הַכֶּ֥בֶשׂ אֶחָ֖ד תַּעֲשֶׂ֣ה בַבֹּ֑קֶר וְאֵת֙ הַכֶּ֣בֶשׂ הַשֵּׁנִ֔י תַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה בֵּ֥ין הָֽעַרְבָּֽיִם׃ וַעֲשִׂירִ֧ית הָאֵיפָ֛ה סֹ֖לֶת לְמִנְחָ֑ה בְּלוּלָ֛ה בְּשֶׁ֥מֶן כָּתִ֖ית רְבִיעִ֥ת הַהִֽין׃

passages.text: This is a regular burnt offering established at Mount Sinai as a pleasing aroma, an offering made by fire to the LORD.
passages.sermon:
God gave Israel instructions at Mount Sinai.
God commanded a regular burnt offering.
The priests must offer this burnt offering every day.
The offering is made by fire.
The offering produces a pleasing aroma.
The offering is for the LORD.
passages.original: עֹלַ֖ת תָּמִ֑יד הָעֲשֻׂיָה֙ בְּהַ֣ר סִינַ֔י לְרֵ֣יחַ נִיחֹ֔חַ אִשֶּׁ֖ה לַֽיהוָֽה׃

passages.text: The drink offering accompanying each lamb shall be a quarter hin. Pour out the offering of fermented drink to the LORD in the sanctuary area.
passages.sermon:
God commanded the Israelites to bring offerings.
Each lamb must have a drink offering.
The drink offering must be a quarter of a hin.
The drink offering must be of fermented drink.
Pour the drink offering out to the LORD.
Pour it out in the sanctuary area.
passages.original: וְנִסְכּוֹ֙ רְבִיעִ֣ת הַהִ֔ין לַכֶּ֖בֶשׂ הָאֶחָ֑ד בַּקֹּ֗דֶשׁ הַסֵּ֛ךְ נֶ֥סֶךְ שֵׁכָ֖ר לַיהוָֽה׃

passages.text: And offer the second lamb at twilight, with the same grain offering and drink offering as in the morning. It is an offering made by fire, a pleasing aroma to the LORD.
passages.sermon:
God commanded the Israelites to bring regular burnt offerings.
They must offer a second lamb every day.
Offer this second lamb at twilight.
Prepare a grain offering with this lamb.
Use the same grain offering as in the morning.
Prepare a drink offering with this lamb.
Use the same drink offering as in the morning.
Burn this offering on the altar.
This offering is a pleasing aroma to the LORD.
This offering is made by fire to the LORD.
passages.original: וְאֵת֙ הַכֶּ֣בֶשׂ הַשֵּׁנִ֔י תַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה בֵּ֣ין הָֽעַרְבָּ֑יִם כְּמִנְחַ֨ת הַבֹּ֤קֶר וּכְנִסְכּוֹ֙ תַּעֲשֶׂ֔ה אִשֵּׁ֛ה רֵ֥יחַ נִיחֹ֖חַ לַיהוָֽה׃פ

passages.text: On the Sabbath day, present two unblemished year-old male lambs, accompanied by a grain offering of two-tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil, as well as a drink offering.
passages.sermon:
On the Sabbath day, present an offering to the LORD.
Bring two male lambs.
Each lamb must be one year old.
Each lamb must have no blemish.
Bring a grain offering with the lambs.
The grain offering is two-tenths of an ephah of fine flour.
Mix the fine flour with oil.
Also bring a drink offering.
passages.original: וּבְיוֹם֙ הַשַּׁבָּ֔ת שְׁנֵֽי־ כְבָשִׂ֥ים בְּנֵֽי־ שָׁנָ֖ה תְּמִימִ֑ם וּשְׁנֵ֣י עֶשְׂרֹנִ֗ים סֹ֧לֶת מִנְחָ֛ה בְּלוּלָ֥ה בַשֶּׁ֖מֶן וְנִסְכּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: This is the burnt offering for every Sabbath, in addition to the regular burnt offering and its drink offering.
passages.sermon:
God commanded the Israelites to bring offerings.
Every Sabbath, they must present a special burnt offering.
This Sabbath burnt offering is in addition to the regular daily burnt offering.
They must also include the drink offering with the regular burnt offering.
passages.original: עֹלַ֥ת שַׁבַּ֖ת בְּשַׁבַּתּ֑וֹ עַל־ עֹלַ֥ת הַתָּמִ֖יד וְנִסְכָּֽהּ׃ס

passages.text: At the beginning of every month, you are to present to the LORD a burnt offering of two young bulls, one ram, and seven male lambs a year old, all unblemished, along with three-tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil as a grain offering with each bull, two-tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil as a grain offering with the ram, and a tenth of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil as a grain offering with each lamb. This is a burnt offering, a pleasing aroma, an offering made by fire to the LORD.
passages.sermon:
At the beginning of every month, you must bring a burnt offering to the LORD.
You must offer two young bulls.
You must offer one ram.
You must offer seven male lambs.
Each lamb must be one year old.
All animals must be unblemished.
With each bull, you must bring a grain offering.
The grain offering for each bull is three-tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil.
With the ram, you must bring a grain offering.
The grain offering for the ram is two-tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil.
With each lamb, you must bring a grain offering.
The grain offering for each lamb is one-tenth of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil.
This is a burnt offering.
This offering is a pleasing aroma.
This is an offering made by fire to the LORD.
passages.original: וּבְרָאשֵׁי֙ חָדְשֵׁיכֶ֔ם תַּקְרִ֥יבוּ עֹלָ֖ה לַיהוָ֑ה פָּרִ֨ים בְּנֵֽי־ בָקָ֤ר שְׁנַ֙יִם֙ וְאַ֣יִל אֶחָ֔ד כְּבָשִׂ֧ים בְּנֵי־ שָׁנָ֛ה שִׁבְעָ֖ה תְּמִימִֽם׃ וּשְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה עֶשְׂרֹנִ֗ים סֹ֤לֶת מִנְחָה֙ בְּלוּלָ֣ה בַשֶּׁ֔מֶן לַפָּ֖ר הָאֶחָ֑ד וּשְׁנֵ֣י עֶשְׂרֹנִ֗ים סֹ֤לֶת מִנְחָה֙ בְּלוּלָ֣ה בַשֶּׁ֔מֶן לָאַ֖יִל הָֽאֶחָֽד׃ וְעִשָּׂרֹ֣ן עִשָּׂר֗וֹן סֹ֤לֶת מִנְחָה֙ בְּלוּלָ֣ה בַשֶּׁ֔מֶן לַכֶּ֖בֶשׂ הָאֶחָ֑ד עֹלָה֙ רֵ֣יחַ נִיחֹ֔חַ אִשֶּׁ֖ה לַיהוָֽה׃

passages.text: Their drink offerings shall be half a hin of wine with each bull, a third of a hin with the ram, and a quarter hin with each lamb. This is the monthly burnt offering to be made at each new moon throughout the year.
passages.sermon:
God commanded the Israelites to bring offerings at the start of every month.
They must bring a burnt offering to the LORD at each new moon.
They must include drink offerings with the animals.
They must give half a hin of wine with each bull.
They must give a third of a hin of wine with the ram.
They must give a quarter of a hin of wine with each lamb.
This is the monthly burnt offering.
They must do this at every new moon throughout the year.
passages.original: וְנִסְכֵּיהֶ֗ם חֲצִ֣י הַהִין֩ יִהְיֶ֨ה לַפָּ֜ר וּשְׁלִישִׁ֧ת הַהִ֣ין לָאַ֗יִל וּרְבִיעִ֥ת הַהִ֛ין לַכֶּ֖בֶשׂ יָ֑יִן זֹ֣את עֹלַ֥ת חֹ֙דֶשׁ֙ בְּחָדְשׁ֔וֹ לְחָדְשֵׁ֖י הַשָּׁנָֽה׃

passages.text: In addition to the regular burnt offering with its drink offering, one male goat is to be presented to the LORD as a sin offering.
passages.sermon:
God commanded the Israelites to bring offerings to Him.
They must offer a regular burnt offering with its drink offering.
They must also present one male goat to the LORD.
This male goat is a sin offering.
They must present the sin offering in addition to the regular burnt offering and its drink offering.
passages.original: וּשְׂעִ֨יר עִזִּ֥ים אֶחָ֛ד לְחַטָּ֖את לַיהוָ֑ה עַל־ עֹלַ֧ת הַתָּמִ֛יד יֵעָשֶׂ֖ה וְנִסְכּֽוֹ׃ס

passages.text: The fourteenth day of the first month is the LORD’s Passover.
passages.sermon: The fourteenth day comes in the first month.\r\nThis day is Passover.\r\nPassover belongs to the LORD.
passages.original: וּבַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הָרִאשׁ֗וֹן בְּאַרְבָּעָ֥ה עָשָׂ֛ר י֖וֹם לַחֹ֑דֶשׁ פֶּ֖סַח לַיהוָֽה׃

passages.text: On the fifteenth day of this month, there shall be a feast; for seven days unleavened bread is to be eaten.
passages.sermon:
God commanded Israel to keep a feast.
This feast begins on the fifteenth day of the first month.
The feast lasts for seven days.
During these seven days, the people must eat unleavened bread.
passages.original: וּבַחֲמִשָּׁ֨ה עָשָׂ֥ר י֛וֹם לַחֹ֥דֶשׁ הַזֶּ֖ה חָ֑ג שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֔ים מַצּ֖וֹת יֵאָכֵֽל׃

passages.text: On the first day there is to be a sacred assembly; you must not do any regular work.
passages.sermon:
God gave Israel a command.
The command is about the Feast of Unleavened Bread.
The first day of this feast is special.
On this day, the people must gather together.
This gathering is a sacred assembly.
No one may do regular work on this day.
passages.original: בַּיּ֥וֹם הָרִאשׁ֖וֹן מִקְרָא־ קֹ֑דֶשׁ כָּל־ מְלֶ֥אכֶת עֲבֹדָ֖ה לֹ֥א תַעֲשֽׂוּ׃

passages.text: Present to the LORD an offering made by fire, a burnt offering of two young bulls, one ram, and seven male lambs a year old, all unblemished.
passages.sermon:
God commanded the Israelites to present an offering to Him.
This offering must be made by fire.
The offering is a burnt offering.
The Israelites must offer two young bulls.
They must offer one ram.
They must offer seven male lambs.
Each lamb must be one year old.
All the animals must be unblemished.
passages.original: וְהִקְרַבְתֶּ֨ם אִשֶּׁ֤ה עֹלָה֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה פָּרִ֧ים בְּנֵי־ בָקָ֛ר שְׁנַ֖יִם וְאַ֣יִל אֶחָ֑ד וְשִׁבְעָ֤ה כְבָשִׂים֙ בְּנֵ֣י שָׁנָ֔ה תְּמִימִ֖ם יִהְי֥וּ לָכֶֽם׃

passages.text: The grain offering shall consist of fine flour mixed with oil; offer three-tenths of an ephah with each bull, two-tenths of an ephah with the ram, and a tenth of an ephah with each of the seven lambs.
passages.sermon:
The grain offering must use fine flour.
Mix the fine flour with oil.
Offer three-tenths of an ephah of this mixture with each bull.
Offer two-tenths of an ephah with the ram.
Offer one-tenth of an ephah with each lamb.
There are seven lambs.
Use this amount for each of the seven lambs.
passages.original: וּמִ֨נְחָתָ֔ם סֹ֖לֶת בְּלוּלָ֣ה בַשָּׁ֑מֶן שְׁלֹשָׁ֨ה עֶשְׂרֹנִ֜ים לַפָּ֗ר וּשְׁנֵ֧י עֶשְׂרֹנִ֛ים לָאַ֖יִל תַּעֲשֽׂוּ׃ עִשָּׂר֤וֹן עִשָּׂרוֹן֙ תַּעֲשֶׂ֔ה לַכֶּ֖בֶשׂ הָאֶחָ֑ד לְשִׁבְעַ֖ת הַכְּבָשִֽׂים׃

passages.text: Include one male goat as a sin offering to make atonement for you.
passages.sermon:
God commanded the people of Israel to bring offerings.
He told them to include one male goat.
This goat is a sin offering.
The sin offering makes atonement for the people.
passages.original: וּשְׂעִ֥יר חַטָּ֖את אֶחָ֑ד לְכַפֵּ֖ר עֲלֵיכֶֽם׃

passages.text: You are to present these in addition to the regular morning burnt offering.
passages.sermon:
God commanded the Israelites to bring offerings.
They must present these offerings every day.
They must do this in addition to the regular morning burnt offering.
The regular morning burnt offering is called the continual burnt offering.
The people must not replace the regular offering with these.
They must offer both.
passages.original: מִלְּבַד֙ עֹלַ֣ת הַבֹּ֔קֶר אֲשֶׁ֖ר לְעֹלַ֣ת הַתָּמִ֑יד תַּעֲשׂ֖וּ אֶת־ אֵֽלֶּה׃

passages.text: Offer the same food each day for seven days as an offering made by fire, a pleasing aroma to the LORD. It is to be offered with its drink offering and the regular burnt offering.
passages.sermon:
God commanded the Israelites to bring offerings to Him.
They must do this for seven days.
Each day, they must offer the same food.
They must burn this food as an offering.
This offering pleases the LORD.
They must also bring a drink offering each day.
They must offer these with the regular burnt offering.
passages.original: כָּאֵ֜לֶּה תַּעֲשׂ֤וּ לַיּוֹם֙ שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֔ים לֶ֛חֶם אִשֵּׁ֥ה רֵֽיחַ־ נִיחֹ֖חַ לַיהוָ֑ה עַל־ עוֹלַ֧ת הַתָּמִ֛יד יֵעָשֶׂ֖ה וְנִסְכּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: On the seventh day you shall hold a sacred assembly; you must not do any regular work.
passages.sermon:
God gave instructions to Israel about their worship and offerings.
He commanded them to observe special days.
On the seventh day, you must gather for a sacred assembly.
This day is holy.
You must not do any regular work on this day.
passages.original: וּבַיּוֹם֙ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֔י מִקְרָא־ קֹ֖דֶשׁ יִהְיֶ֣ה לָכֶ֑ם כָּל־ מְלֶ֥אכֶת עֲבֹדָ֖ה לֹ֥א תַעֲשֽׂוּ׃ס

passages.text: On the day of firstfruits, when you present an offering of new grain to the LORD during the Feast of Weeks, you are to hold a sacred assembly; you must not do any regular work.
passages.sermon:
The LORD commanded Israel to celebrate the Feast of Weeks.
This feast is also called the day of firstfruits.
On this day, you must bring an offering of new grain to the LORD.
You must gather for a sacred assembly.
You must not do any regular work on this day.
passages.original: וּבְי֣וֹם הַבִּכּוּרִ֗ים בְּהַקְרִ֨יבְכֶ֜ם מִנְחָ֤ה חֲדָשָׁה֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה בְּשָׁבֻעֹ֖תֵיכֶ֑ם מִֽקְרָא־ קֹ֙דֶשׁ֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה לָכֶ֔ם כָּל־ מְלֶ֥אכֶת עֲבֹדָ֖ה לֹ֥א תַעֲשֽׂוּ׃

passages.text: Present a burnt offering of two young bulls, one ram, and seven male lambs a year old as a pleasing aroma to the LORD, together with their grain offerings of fine flour mixed with oil—three-tenths of an ephah with each bull, two-tenths of an ephah with the ram, and a tenth of an ephah with each of the seven lambs.
passages.sermon:
You must present a burnt offering to the LORD.
This offering will be a pleasing aroma to Him.
You must offer two young bulls.
You must offer one ram.
You must offer seven male lambs.
Each lamb must be one year old.
You must also bring grain offerings with these animals.
Use fine flour mixed with oil for the grain offerings.
Give three-tenths of an ephah of flour with each bull.
Give two-tenths of an ephah of flour with the ram.
Give one-tenth of an ephah of flour with each of the seven lambs.
passages.original: וְהִקְרַבְתֶּ֨ם עוֹלָ֜ה לְרֵ֤יחַ נִיחֹ֙חַ֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה פָּרִ֧ים בְּנֵי־ בָקָ֛ר שְׁנַ֖יִם אַ֣יִל אֶחָ֑ד שִׁבְעָ֥ה כְבָשִׂ֖ים בְּנֵ֥י שָׁנָֽה׃ וּמִנְחָתָ֔ם סֹ֖לֶת בְּלוּלָ֣ה בַשָּׁ֑מֶן שְׁלֹשָׁ֤ה עֶשְׂרֹנִים֙ לַפָּ֣ר הָֽאֶחָ֔ד שְׁנֵי֙ עֶשְׂרֹנִ֔ים לָאַ֖יִל הָאֶחָֽד׃ עִשָּׂרוֹן֙ עִשָּׂר֔וֹן לַכֶּ֖בֶשׂ הָאֶחָ֑ד לְשִׁבְעַ֖ת הַכְּבָשִֽׂים׃

passages.text: Include one male goat to make atonement for you.
passages.sermon:
God commanded the Israelites to bring offerings to Him.
He told them to include a male goat in their offerings.
This male goat will make atonement for the people.
The atonement will cover their sins before God.
passages.original: שְׂעִ֥יר עִזִּ֖ים אֶחָ֑ד לְכַפֵּ֖ר עֲלֵיכֶֽם׃

passages.text: Offer them with their drink offerings in addition to the regular burnt offering and its grain offering. The animals must be unblemished.
passages.sermon: You must offer these animals with their drink offerings.\r\nYou must also offer them with the regular burnt offering and its grain offering.\r\nThe animals you bring must be unblemished.
passages.original: מִלְּבַ֞ד עֹלַ֧ת הַתָּמִ֛יד וּמִנְחָת֖וֹ תַּעֲשׂ֑וּ תְּמִימִ֥ם יִהְיוּ־ לָכֶ֖ם וְנִסְכֵּיהֶֽם׃פ
